title: Refer Friends, Earn Perks — The Quest Crew Way
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Express Boat Club members earn $300 toward their membership renewal for every friend or family member they refer who joins.
body_html:
Turn your boat days into savings — refer friends, earn rewards, repeat.

Because boating’s better with your favorite people.

Let’s be honest: half the fun of boating is showing off how easy you’ve got it. No trailering, no scrubbing, no wrench-turning. Just sunshine, smooth cruising, and someone inevitably asking, “Wait, you don’t have to do ANY of the work?”

And now, sharing that secret pays off — literally.

For every friend or family member you refer who joins Quest Express Boat Club, you’ll get $300 toward your membership renewal. Yep — three hundred dollars just for being a good influence and knowing cool people.

There’s no cap on how many credits you can earn, so if you suddenly become the Oprah of boating invites…

“You get a boat day! You get a boat day! Everybody gets a boat day!”

What’s better than a summer full of river memories? A summer full of river memories you didn’t have to pay full price for.

Refer a friend, get a discount

Here’s how to cash in on the current

  • Invite a friend out for a day on the water.
  • Show them how effortless (and fun) club life is.
  • They join → you get $300 credit.
  • Repeat and watch next season practically pay for itself.

Because boating should be shared — the laughter, the sunsets, the freedom, and yes, even the perfectly packed snack cooler.

Bring your crew. Earn your rewards. Repeat.

Learn more or refer a friend on our Quest Express Boat Club page | 815-433-2200
